name: Monza 1966 - Combined Circuit
description: The Autodromo Nazionale di Monza as it stood in the sixties, with the 1955 sopraelevata banking joined to the road course to make a ten-kilometre lap. The combination carried the Monza 1000 km through the second half of the decade; the banking was abandoned for racing after 1969 and still stands, crumbling, in the park.
